```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
has_plotly <- requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_plotly) {
  plotly_dependencies <- htmltools::findDependencies(plotly::plot_ly())
  plotly_main <- Filter(function(dep) identical(dep$name, "plotly-main"),
                        plotly_dependencies)
  has_plotly <- length(plotly_main) == 1L && file.exists(file.path(
    plotly_main[[1L]]$src$file, plotly_main[[1L]]$script
  ))
}

.interactive_plot <- function(plot) {
  if (has_plotly) {
    plotly::ggplotly(plot, tooltip = "text") |>
      plotly::config(displayModeBar = TRUE, scrollZoom = TRUE)
  } else {
    plot
  }
}

.qc_umap_plot <- function(obj, color_by, title) {
  embedding <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(obj, "umap"))
  if (ncol(embedding) < 2L) return(NULL)
  embedding <- embedding[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  names(embedding) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  embedding$cell <- rownames(embedding)
  embedding$group <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[color_by]])
  p <- ggplot(embedding, aes(
    UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = group,
    text = paste("Cell:", cell, "<br>", color_by, ":", group)
  )) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.75) +
    labs(title = title, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", color = color_by) +
    theme_minimal()
  .interactive_plot(p)
}

# `%||%` is exported by SPARKS but is not on the search path when the package is
# only loaded (SPARKS::sparks()), and base R only has it from 4.4.0.
if (!exists("%||%", mode = "function")) {
  `%||%` <- function(lhs, rhs) if (is.null(lhs) || length(lhs) == 0L) rhs else lhs
}
```

```{r load-obj}
obj <- params$seurat_obj
if (is.null(obj)) stop("No Seurat object provided")
group  <- params$comp_group
out_dir <- params$out_dir
cfg    <- params$cfg   # may be NULL when report is rendered standalone
```

# QC Report: `r group`

## Summary of the dataset

```{r summary}
total_cells <- ncol(obj)
total_genes <- nrow(obj)
cells_by_sample <- if ("orig.ident" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) table(obj$orig.ident) else integer(0)
cells_by_condition <- if ("condition" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) table(obj$condition) else integer(0)
```

| Metric                | Value                                          |
|-----------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| **Total cells**       | `r total_cells`                                |
| **Total genes**       | `r total_genes`                                |
| **Samples**           | `r if ("orig.ident" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) length(unique(obj$orig.ident)) else "Not available"` |
| **Conditions**        | `r if ("condition" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) length(unique(obj$condition)) else "Not available"` |

**Cells per sample:**
```{r cells-by-sample, results='asis'}
if (length(cells_by_sample)) {
  print(kable(as.data.frame(cells_by_sample), col.names = c("Sample", "Number of cells")))
} else {
  cat("_(Sample metadata not available.)_\n")
}
```

**Cells per condition:**
```{r cells-by-condition, results='asis'}
if (length(cells_by_condition)) {
  print(kable(as.data.frame(cells_by_condition), col.names = c("Condition", "Number of cells")))
} else {
  cat("_(Condition metadata not available.)_\n")
}
```

## Input data

```{r input-data, results='asis'}
if ("quant_format" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) {
  fmt_df <- unique(obj@meta.data[, c("orig.ident", "quant_format"), drop = FALSE])
  colnames(fmt_df) <- c("Sample", "Format")
  # BUG FIX: a bare kable() inside an if-block is never auto-printed, so this
  # table silently never appeared in the report.
  print(kable(fmt_df))
  if (!is.null(cfg) && isTRUE(cfg$input$save_raw_matrix)) {
    cat("\nRaw, pre-QC count matrices were saved per sample under ",
        "`results_dir/", group, "/RawMatrix/<folder_id>/` in ",
        cfg$input$raw_matrix_format %||% "mtx", " format.\n", sep = "")
  }
} else {
  cat("_(Input format metadata not available for this run.)_\n")
}
```

## Filtering history

```{r filtering-params, results='asis'}
# cfg is forwarded from the pipeline; show thresholds when available.
if (!is.null(cfg)) {
  params_df <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c(
      "Min features", "Max features", "Max counts",
      "Max mitochondrial %", "Gene removal pattern"
    ),
    Value = c(
      cfg$qc$min_features,
      cfg$qc$max_features  %||% "N/A",
      cfg$qc$max_counts,
      cfg$qc$max_mt_percent,
      cfg$species$gene_removal_pattern
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  print(kable(params_df))
} else {
  cat("_(Config not available – run via `sparks()` to populate this section.)_\n")
}
```

Doublet removal used scDblFinder.

Per-sample doublet statistics are linked in the downloadable files section below.

## QC metrics after filtering

```{r qc-violin, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
qc_features <- intersect(c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                          colnames(obj[[]]))
if (length(qc_features)) {
  metadata <- obj@meta.data
  metadata$sample <- if ("orig.ident" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    as.character(metadata$orig.ident)
  } else "All cells"
  qc_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
    metadata[, c(qc_features, "sample"), drop = FALSE],
    cols = all_of(qc_features), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value"
  )
  p <- ggplot(qc_long, aes(sample, value, fill = sample,
                           text = paste("Sample:", sample,
                                        "<br>Metric:", metric,
                                        "<br>Value:", signif(value, 4)))) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = min(3L, length(qc_features))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30,
                                                                  hjust = 1))
  .interactive_plot(p)
} else {
  cat("QC metric columns are not available in this object.\n")
}
```

```{r qc-scatter, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
scatter_features <- intersect(c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA"),
                              colnames(obj[[]]))
if (all(c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA") %in% scatter_features)) {
  scatter_data <- obj@meta.data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      cell = rownames(obj@meta.data),
      nCount_RNA = .data$nCount_RNA,
      percent.mt = .data$percent.mt,
      nFeature_RNA = .data$nFeature_RNA
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(percent.mt, nFeature_RNA), names_to = "metric",
                        values_to = "value")
  p <- ggplot(scatter_data, aes(
    nCount_RNA, value,
    text = paste("Cell:", cell, "<br>nCount_RNA:", nCount_RNA,
                 "<br>", metric, ":", signif(value, 4))
  )) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "nCount_RNA", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal()
  .interactive_plot(p)
} else {
  cat("Scatter plot metadata is not available.\n")
}
```

## Doublet detection

```{r doublets}
if ("scDblFinder.class" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) {
  dtab <- table(obj$scDblFinder.class)
  print(kable(as.data.frame(dtab), col.names = c("Class", "Number of cells")))
} else {
  cat("No doublet classification found in the merged object.",
      "(Doublets were removed before merging; see per-sample stats in the QC folder.)\n")
}
```

## Cell cycle and sex scoring

```{r scoring}
if ("S.Score" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) {
  cat("**Cell cycle phase distribution**\n")
  print(kable(as.data.frame(table(Phase = obj$Phase)),
              col.names = c("Phase", "Cells")))
}
if ("Assigned_Sex" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) {
  cat("\n**Sex assignment**\n")

              col.names = c("Sex", "Cells")))
}
if (!"S.Score" %in% colnames(obj[[]]) && !"Assigned_Sex" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) {
  cat("Cell cycle and sex scoring were not run for this dataset.\n")
}
```

## Clustering overview

Number of clusters: `r if ("seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) length(unique(obj$seurat_clusters)) else "Not available"`

```{r umap, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (!"seurat_clusters" %in% colnames(obj[[]])) {
  cat("Cluster metadata is not available.\n")
} else if (!"umap" %in% names(obj@reductions)) {
  cat("UMAP reduction is not available.\n")
} else {
  .qc_umap_plot(obj, "seurat_clusters", paste("UMAP -", group))
}
```

## Pipeline diagnostics

```{r diagnostics, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$log_path) && file.exists(params$log_path)) {
  log_lines <- readLines(params$log_path, warn = FALSE)
  diagnostics <- grep("\\[(WARNING|ERROR)\\]", log_lines, value = TRUE)
  skips <- grep("\\[SKIP", log_lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(diagnostics) || length(skips)) {
    diagnostic_df <- data.frame(
      Type = c(rep("Warning/error", length(diagnostics)),
               rep("Skipped/unavailable", length(skips))),
      Message = c(diagnostics, skips),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    print(kable(diagnostic_df))
  } else {
    cat("No warnings, errors, or skipped analyses were logged.")
  }
} else {
  cat("Pipeline log is not available.")
}
```
